why: real-v2 holds 4 held-out accept labels and its 310 jobs can reach about 10, below the 30 of rule 6; most of its jobs were collected under the owner's previous profile

collection.where: the isolated labelling install, in a new database data/real-v3/jobs.db that holds only real-v3 scans; never the V1 install or its database
collection.scans: one or more full scans with that profile, all made before the export, all into data/real-v3/jobs.db
collection.excluded: the 2026-11-03 21:15 UTC scan stored in that install's data/jobs.db ran with an earlier profile (profile_hash 59ce613edecc1b2a) and is not part of real-v3

export.command: python -m src.evaluation export --db data/real-v3/jobs.db --out data/benchmarks/real-v3 --dataset-id real-v3 --n 400 --rejected 100 --top-scored 0 --seed 20261103
export.copied_to: data/calibration/real-v3, labelled there; data/benchmarks/real-v3 is never written after the export

rule: README.md 'Decision rule' 1-8 unchanged, with real-v3 in place of real-v2 and this profile
pooling: none: real-v2 and real-v3 are decided and reported separately, never merged
when_to_run: once, after the owner reports labelling finished; no held-out result is computed before that
evidence_threshold: rule 6: below 30 accept labels in the real-v3 held-out cohort the result is exploratory
